normative_requirement: Organization creation, membership, invitations and organization switching enforce server-side tenant access.
acceptance_evidence: Two tenants cannot read or change each other's records through altered IDs or organization selectors.

normative_requirement: Role checks apply to screens, APIs, jobs, files, reports and sensitive fields.
acceptance_evidence: A role denied an operation cannot perform it through another interface.

normative_requirement: Secure sessions, recovery, privileged MFA and audit records protect administrative and sensitive operations.
acceptance_evidence: Revoked sessions fail; privileged changes and controlled exports have actor, tenant, timestamp and outcome.

normative_requirement: Tenant settings control service/product journeys, schedules, timezone, templates and integration health.
acceptance_evidence: An unconfigured journey is unavailable and creates a staff task rather than presenting invented availability.

normative_requirement: Contacts support separate leads/opportunities, sources, channel identities, owners and activity histories.
acceptance_evidence: A returning customer can open a new opportunity without losing earlier appointments, orders or source evidence.

normative_requirement: Manual and inbound capture normalize phone numbers; merges require trusted evidence or audited staff review.
acceptance_evidence: Same-name Instagram and WhatsApp users are not automatically merged; approved merges preserve histories.

normative_requirement: Configurable pipelines, stage transitions, notes, tasks and follow-up dates support all four journeys.
acceptance_evidence: A lead can be assigned and progressed; unauthorized stage changes fail and valid changes appear in its timeline.

normative_requirement: Contacts support tags, custom fields, companies, filtering, saved views and static lists.
acceptance_evidence: Filters select matching records within the tenant; field and company updates persist.

normative_requirement: Controlled CSV import/export validates rows and supports manual or configured round-robin assignment.
acceptance_evidence: Bad rows have actionable errors; repeated import does not silently duplicate contacts; export requires permission.

normative_requirement: Saved rules dynamically segment contacts and explain deterministic lead scores; eligible audience sync follows provider approval.
acceptance_evidence: Changed facts update segment membership; a score exposes its rule and inputs; audience sync requires explicit permission and consent.

normative_requirement: Conversations provide ownership, unread state, history, internal notes and permitted replies.
acceptance_evidence: An assigned operator can work a conversation; internal notes are never sent to the customer.

normative_requirement: Takeover pauses customer-facing bot conversation steps until an authorized operator explicitly resumes automation.
acceptance_evidence: A queued bot reply is blocked after takeover; permitted transactional reminders continue under their own rules.

normative_requirement: Supported attachments, saved replies and provider-reported message states are stored with evidence.
acceptance_evidence: Provider acceptance is distinguished from delivery/read; unsupported status remains unknown.

normative_requirement: Tenant-specific website forms and authenticated external ingestion create leads with source and consent evidence.
acceptance_evidence: Valid repeated submissions reconcile safely; unauthorized ingestion and spam controls are enforced.

normative_requirement: Official adapter validates callbacks, protects credentials and surfaces account connection state.
acceptance_evidence: Valid inbound events reach the correct tenant; invalid signatures do not create records.

normative_requirement: The menu routes to Work From Home, Online/Offline Free Consultation, Chiropractic Treatment and Ayurvedic Products through eligible formats.
acceptance_evidence: All four choices reach the intended workflow; a numbered-text fallback and invalid-input recovery work.

normative_requirement: Every send checks current permission, consent purpose, channel restrictions, template status and business status.
acceptance_evidence: An opt-out after scheduling blocks prohibited marketing at dispatch; blocked sends show a reason and staff next step.

normative_requirement: Supported templates/statuses, account errors and credential expiry/revocation have sync and reconnection flows.
acceptance_evidence: A rejected template cannot be sent; disconnect does not erase CRM history or claim messages were delivered.

normative_requirement: Collect full name, observed/validated phone, city, state and communication preferences before completing registration.
acceptance_evidence: Missing fields prompt correction; completion creates/updates CRM, sends permitted welcome and records available source.

normative_requirement: Provide configured invitation/session details, reminders, attendance evidence, pipeline updates and staff follow-up.
acceptance_evidence: Invitation sent does not imply joined; unavailable attendance stays unknown or staff recorded; duplicate input does not enroll twice.

normative_requirement: Configure consultation mode, practitioner/location, durations, capacity, working hours, holidays, price and timezone.
acceptance_evidence: Only configured available slots are offered; both resource and customer conflicts are checked.

normative_requirement: The pilot offline free-consultation template enables a tenant/service-configurable Monday-only rule.
acceptance_evidence: A non-Monday date in the business timezone fails while an eligible Monday slot can be booked.

normative_requirement: Atomic capacity checks support confirmed bookings, cancellation, rescheduling, attendance and no-show with customer management links.
acceptance_evidence: Concurrent requests cannot exceed capacity; rescheduling preserves history and releases the old slot.

normative_requirement: Schedule 24-hour and 2-hour reminders, staff notifications and post-completion feedback using current appointment version.
acceptance_evidence: Past reminder times are skipped; cancelled/replaced bookings send no obsolete reminder; staff can inspect blocked sends.

normative_requirement: Authorized meeting adapters create/update sessions and ingest supported registration/attendance events.
acceptance_evidence: Provider success is verified; booking changes update meetings where supported and failures create actionable tasks. Phase 9: Zoom OAuth (PKCE) connection, meeting create/patch/delete per appointment version with reconcile-never-recreate on ambiguity, optional registration, signed webhook attendance evidence (evidence only; staff record the outcome), meeting_sync / meeting_outcome tasks; tests src/lib/meetings/meeting-sync.integration.test.ts and zoom-webhook.integration.test.ts. Off until ZOOM_ENABLED and Zoom app approval.

normative_requirement: Products support categories, SKUs, variants, images, search, prices, availability and reviewed disclosures/claims.
acceptance_evidence: Only published purchasable stock appears; price/SKU changes do not alter past order snapshots. Pilot: Bodhinox catalogue with categories, variants, images, reviewed publish, archive, Meta link and draft import; push to Meta deferred (catalogue.integration.test.ts).

normative_requirement: A tenant storefront supports quantity changes, addresses, item-level totals, configured coupons, delivery fees and tax inputs.
acceptance_evidence: Server totals recompute correctly; manipulated client prices and unauthorized cart links are rejected. Pilot: server pricing, tax, shipping rates and coupons; contact-bound storefront links (pricing.test.ts, coupons.integration.test.ts, shop-routes.integration.test.ts).

normative_requirement: Reservations, expiry, stock movements, low-stock alerts and adjustments form one inventory source of truth.
acceptance_evidence: Concurrent checkout cannot oversell; retries do not deduct twice; delayed payment after expiry enters an exception. Pilot: reservations, expiry, append-only stock ledger, staff adjustments and low-stock alerts; oversell gate in stock.integration.test.ts (20 buyers, 5 units).

normative_requirement: Orders have unique identifiers, immutable item/price snapshots, status history and scoped customer access.
acceptance_evidence: A customer link cannot expose another order; cancelled/returned states retain history and financial evidence. Pilot: price-frozen snapshots, order history and storefront links scoped to one contact and one order (orders-guard.integration.test.ts).

normative_requirement: Staff can apply configured cancellation/return rules, initiate approved refunds and record condition-based stock restoration.
acceptance_evidence: Refund success requires gateway evidence; pending/failed refunds remain visible and resalable stock is not assumed. Pilot: cancel and refund, returns with restock or discard, refunds settled only from Razorpay outcomes (refunds.integration.test.ts, order-lifecycle.integration.test.ts).

normative_requirement: Verified order feedback/reviews, low-stock notification configuration and consent-aware product retention workflows are supported.
acceptance_evidence: Feedback is linked to the appropriate order; opt-outs prevent remarketing; stock alerts reflect actual movements. Pilot: staff-recorded feedback score, feedback request and product follow-up (Utility templates only), low-stock alerts and per-variant threshold; reviews deferred.

normative_requirement: Each tenant connects an authorized merchant account; configured UPI-capable checkout and payment links pay that tenant.
acceptance_evidence: Payment attempts reference the intended tenant, merchant, order, amount and currency; no raw card data is stored. Pilot: tenant Razorpay payment links (UPI) for orders and paid appointments; settlement only after authoritative fetches.

normative_requirement: Validate trusted gateway events/responses and prevent duplicate/out-of-order payment effects.
acceptance_evidence: Invalid signatures, wrong merchant/amount/currency and replay cannot mark an order paid or duplicate transactions. Pilot: duplicate-webhook and concurrent-reconcile gate in settle.integration.test.ts; success pages never settle.

normative_requirement: Payment attempts, captures, completed refunds, gateway references and configured receipts/invoices reconcile to orders.
acceptance_evidence: A paid order has trusted payment evidence; missing/conflicting events produce reconciliation exceptions. Pilot: receipts and credit notes, payment exceptions, reconciliation report and sweep (refunds.integration.test.ts, documents.integration.test.ts).

normative_requirement: Staff record dispatch/delivery with audit and evidence; automated status uses verified provider events when connected.
acceptance_evidence: No notice claims provider-confirmed delivery from an unverified event; staff-confirmed events are labeled. Pilot: staff-recorded dispatch and delivery labelled as such, with tracking note and customer notices; Phase 9: dispatch/delivery evidence is "Courier confirmed" only from Shiprocket data read back with the workspace's credentials, otherwise "Staff recorded" or "Not confirmed"; dispatched notices carry the courier tracking link when an AWB exists (FUL-02).

normative_requirement: An approved courier adapter creates shipments, normalizes tracking and reconciles later corrections.
acceptance_evidence: Reordered/repeated tracking cannot send duplicate notices or move delivered shipments backward without reviewed correction. Phase 9 (Shiprocket): verified read-back only, order-independent fold over stored scans, notices at most once per order and kind, reviewed corrections (accept/dismiss), contradiction/RTO/lost/order-conflict exceptions, ambiguous create/AWB never repeated; gate test src/lib/fulfilment/tracking.integration.test.ts. Off until a workspace connects Shiprocket.

normative_requirement: Business events publish reliably with idempotent consumers, durable execution history and preset workflows.
acceptance_evidence: Duplicate delivery and worker restart do not repeat completed domain effects.

normative_requirement: Timezone-aware delays, cancellation, retry backoff, dead letters, loop limits and eligible replay support the four journeys.
acceptance_evidence: A stale queued reminder is blocked at dispatch; repeated failure is inspectable; replay skips completed effects.

normative_requirement: Preset configuration has draft/published/paused/archived states, immutable versions and a no-side-effect test mode.
acceptance_evidence: Runs retain their starting published version; dry run cannot send messages, change stock or charge money.

normative_requirement: Business users author validated trigger/condition/action graphs, branches and delays using implemented node types.
acceptance_evidence: Disconnected/invalid or unbounded-loop graphs cannot publish; permissions govern publication and replay.

normative_requirement: Support the master prompt's triggers, conditions and actions through versioned domain contracts and authorized external webhooks.
acceptance_evidence: Every exposed node executes its documented action or reports a capability block; external calls cannot access restricted network destinations.

normative_requirement: Eligible professional accounts connect with approved authorization and supported messaging/webhooks.
acceptance_evidence: Live tests pass for the selected route and permissions; disconnection/revocation has an actionable state.

normative_requirement: Supported keyword/private-reply/comment workflows reuse CRM, handoff, appointments and commerce with channel-specific dispatch checks.
acceptance_evidence: Unavailable events remain unavailable; current restrictions and reliable identity matching are enforced.

normative_requirement: Connect eligible ad accounts and sync campaign/ad-set/ad hierarchy, daily spend and supported metrics with freshness status.
acceptance_evidence: Pagination/retries/backfill do not duplicate snapshots; failed/stale sync is visible.

normative_requirement: Campaign/ad comparisons, supported breakdowns, date ranges, budgets and spend alerts distinguish unavailable metrics.
acceptance_evidence: Values agree with the selected provider basis; non-additive metrics such as reach are not blindly summed.

normative_requirement: Authorized campaign creation/publishing or budget edits need explicit user confirmation, permissions, configured safeguards and audit.
acceptance_evidence: Read-only users cannot mutate ads; no AI recommendation or workflow silently increases spend.

normative_requirement: Capture available referrals, source IDs, timestamps and consent evidence when leads arrive.
acceptance_evidence: Missing evidence is unknown; subsequent conversations do not overwrite original touchpoint history.

normative_requirement: Use last identifiable eligible marketing touch within 30 days before conversion; store model/version and conversion-specific decision.
acceptance_evidence: Out-of-window or absent evidence leaves conversions unattributed; refunds retain the original attribution allocation.

normative_requirement: Tenant-controlled windows and documented first-touch/last-touch model choices support versioned report recalculation.
acceptance_evidence: Historical model changes are explicit; a report states model, window, currency, coverage and time basis.

normative_requirement: Report leads, qualification, bookings, attendance, orders, verified collections, refunds, spend and attributed net merchandise revenue.
acceptance_evidence: Totals reconcile to source ledgers; gross sales, collections and attributed revenue are labeled separately; zero denominators show N/A.

normative_requirement: Daily/weekly/monthly/custom reports, CSV/spreadsheet exports, PDF reports and controlled sharing respect tenant/role restrictions.
acceptance_evidence: Scheduled generation and file download both check authorization; shared links are scoped and expire.

normative_requirement: Record actual product, gateway, fulfilment, advertising and included variable costs with completeness indicators.
acceptance_evidence: Missing required cost inputs prevent a complete-profit claim; estimated contribution states included/excluded costs.

normative_requirement: Provide summaries, suggested replies, intent detection, qualification assistance and lead prioritization with staff review.
acceptance_evidence: Suggestions show relevant source context and do not become customer messages without operator action.

normative_requirement: Permission-aware tenant knowledge retrieval and defined report queries support answers with evidence and freshness.
acceptance_evidence: Cross-tenant prompts/retrieval fail; unsupported answers abstain or hand off; financial claims reconcile to reporting.

normative_requirement: Evaluate leakage, hallucination and instruction attacks; enforce usage limits, retention and medical/product-claim restrictions.
acceptance_evidence: AI cannot diagnose, invent cure claims or independently confirm payment/attendance/delivery.

normative_requirement: Configurable contact/user/integration/workflow/message limits and exactly-once business usage records govern plan access.
acceptance_evidence: Retries do not double-meter; quota exhaustion pauses eligible new actions without preventing payment reconciliation. Pilot: race-free contact (inbound exempt), seat, integration, active flow and automation limits and AI usage metered once per source event with reservations (limits-metering.integration.test.ts); monthly message limits are displayed and warned about but not enforced (deferred).

normative_requirement: Monthly/annual billing, subscription changes, billing records and grace states are separate from customer commerce payments.
acceptance_evidence: Subscription webhooks reconcile independently; no tenant purchase funds are counted as platform subscription revenue. Provider-gated on the platform Razorpay keys: versioned plans with pinned subscriptions, daily read-only reconciliation and a platform reconciliation queue; no foreign key or webhook crosses SaaS billing and commerce (reconciliation.integration.test.ts, separation.integration.test.ts).

normative_requirement: Self-service signup, marketing website, setup wizard and audited platform support/tenant administration are available.
acceptance_evidence: Support has no standing unrestricted tenant-data access; temporary scoped access is authorized and audited. Pilot: restricted platform console (allowlist, MFA, 404 otherwise), consented time-limited diagnostics audited in both trails, tenant lifecycle, onboarding checklist (console.integration.test.ts); the marketing site is minimal and the legal text is a draft.

normative_requirement: Minimize health details; enforce field/role controls, consent purpose, retention, export, deletion and disconnection workflows.
acceptance_evidence: Sensitive notes never enter marketing content; verified data requests complete through policy-aware audited processing.

normative_requirement: Server validation, secret protection, secure sessions, rate limits, applicable CSRF protection, upload safety and webhook authentication apply.
acceptance_evidence: Hostile input/upload, forged callbacks and secrets in application outputs fail security checks.

normative_requirement: Tenant isolation extends to cache, search, storage, queues, streams, reports and future AI retrieval.
acceptance_evidence: Adversarial cross-tenant tests cover every listed surface with no successful unauthorized access.

normative_requirement: Current provider/account and product-policy review is a live gate; privacy/disconnection disclosures and responsible business review are required.
acceptance_evidence: Restricted capabilities stay disabled; a mock or pending approval is never shown as a live permission.

normative_requirement: Monitoring, failure alerts, backups, restore drills, incident ownership and rollout/rollback runbooks protect the pilot.
acceptance_evidence: A restore meets documented recovery targets; queue/provider failures are visible and have an assigned response owner.

normative_requirement: Responsive critical flows support keyboard use, labeled controls and declared load/latency targets.
acceptance_evidence: Critical tasks work on desktop/mobile; measured results pass the PRD performance profile without affecting financial invariants.

normative_requirement: Migrations, automated checks, API/config/setup docs and labeled seeds ship with modules; track implemented/tested/simulated/live separately.
acceptance_evidence: A clean environment starts using documented setup; tests and release evidence are reproducible.

normative_requirement: Reserve extension paths for multiple connected accounts, agencies, white label and additional industries without immediate pilot UI.
acceptance_evidence: Later scope is separately specified; pilot data/contracts do not assume one universal business account.

normative_requirement: Every exposed control performs its authorized action; screens provide loading, empty, validation, success, error and disconnected states with responsive accessible layouts.
acceptance_evidence: Available controls persist/perform their intended action; unavailable capabilities are hidden or explicitly disabled with a reason; critical forms work by keyboard.

normative_requirement: Consent records retain purpose, channel, source, timestamp, notice/version and withdrawal; service communication and marketing permission are evaluated separately.
acceptance_evidence: Missing or withdrawn marketing consent cannot be inferred from booking/purchase; exports and send decisions preserve the relevant evidence.

normative_requirement: Approved lead-form events and authorized lead retrieval create CRM records with available form/campaign evidence.
acceptance_evidence: Only eligible authorized forms are synchronized; duplicate events do not duplicate leads and missing permissions are visible.

normative_requirement: Record other included business expenses and show estimated operating results only with a declared revenue/cost basis and completeness.
acceptance_evidence: Missing expense categories are disclosed; taxes, gross profit, campaign contribution and estimated operating results are distinct.

normative_requirement: The ad referral on an inbound WhatsApp message is stored per conversation and contact, counted as an ad conversation source and usable as a flow/automation trigger and a segment condition, without any outbound Meta call.
acceptance_evidence: A redelivered message stores one referral; a malformed referral never drops the message; members never see the click id; tenants cannot see each other's referrals.

normative_requirement: Purchases, lead submissions and flow conversion steps for ad-attributed contacts are reported to Meta once per deterministic event id, only when the workspace enabled it for the dataset's WhatsApp account.
acceptance_evidence: A payment-link and a manual order for the same order report one Purchase; ambiguous sends are held for admin review and never re-sent automatically; with the feature off nothing is queued.
